mechanism.forced_participant: Accounts under event-mandated flat-through-print policies (prop-desk risk limits, mandate clauses that forbid holding through scheduled US macro prints) that MUST complete their desired flow in the k bars BEFORE the instant. Their deadline is the public FOMC schedule; the coercion is the clock, not any endogenous market state.
mechanism.late_participant: Post-print discretionary flow that only re-engages after uncertainty resolves; the pre-print pressure direction realizes (is confirmed and extended, or the announcement-bar counter-move retraces) against this late crowd.
mechanism.why_effect_exists: Deadline flow is informed-but-urgent: it transacts in the hours while quote providers are still present (before their own print withdrawal), accumulating one-sided taker pressure in the pre-window. When the decision lands and uncertainty resolves, price drifts toward the direction of that accumulated pressure over the following hours - the pre-window pressure is a measure of who was forced to act early, and the post-print market slowly prices what they knew.
when_it_must_fail: If pre-print flow is uninformed de-risking (noise around a deadline), post-print drift toward it is statistically zero: anchor after-cost expectancy indistinguishable from zero.
If the effect is generic H1 imbalance autocorrelation with no clock content, the sham-instant placebo reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x).
If the book is really the sibling P1 bet (announcement-bar side), the cross-representation pooled |rho| > 0.20 collapses the pair (F5).
If the observable secretly encodes a liquidity/VOLUME level rather than a bounded pressure ratio, D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs the dvol proxies (WKNDLIQ's killers) vetoes it.

observable_pinned.definition: press(symbol, s, k) = (sum of buy_quote over bars A-k..A-1 - sum of sell_quote over bars A-k..A-1) / (sum of quote_total over bars A-k..A-1), a bounded net-pressure ratio in [-1, +1] computed BEFORE the instant on bars that are fully closed PIT
observable_pinned.instant_source: p0_calendar_census.json instants (series US-MACRO/FOMC_DECISION), DST-correct UTC per official 'For release at 2:00 p.m. EST/EDT' evidence

clock.bar: H1 UTC from the frozen S4 panels, bar hour_utc=T covers [T, T+1h)
clock.announcement_bar: A(s) = the bar whose hour_utc equals the instant's UTC hour on the instant's date (the release lands on A's open boundary; e.g. 2026-01-28T19:00:00Z -> bar '2026-01-28T19')
clock.pre_window: bars A-k..A-1 (the k bars immediately before the announcement bar, same UTC day for k <= 6 at these instants)
clock.decision: at the CLOSE of bar A(s): the full pre-window AND the full announcement bar are point-in-time at decision time; entry is deliberately AFTER the print so the trade tests post-resolution realization, not the print itself
clock.instant_alignment: UTC, DST-correct from census evidence (14:00 EDT = 18:00Z; 14:00 EST = 19:00Z); no CPI/NFP instants exist and none are used

warmup.rule: an instant is eligible only if the symbol has >= 500 prior H1 bars in the panel before the instant's date AND all k pre-window bars exist
warmup.coverage: panel starts 2025-08-22T00; first instant 2025-09-17 has 624 bars >= 500 and pre-window bars 14:00..17:00Z exist; therefore ALL 8 instants x 3 symbols are eligible; no instant dropped
warmup.signal_history: none required beyond the k-bar pre-window itself (no threshold fitting exists)

columns_from_panel.buy_quote: USD notional of buy-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.sell_quote: USD notional of sell-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.last_price: last traded price in bar, used as the bar-close fill price

features_lags.lag_structure: windowed feature at lags -1..-k relative to the announcement bar (anchor k=4, i.e. bars A-4..A-1); decision lag 0 (close of A); exit price at lag +H (close of A+H). Volume enters only as a bounded ratio denominator; no volume LEVEL is used anywhere.

entry_exit_fills.direction: d = sign(press) = sign((SUM buy_quote - SUM sell_quote)/(SUM quote_total)) over bars A-k..A-1; tie (numerator exactly 0) -> decision recorded UNFUNDED_SKIP (counted, not silently dropped)
entry_exit_fills.entry: at close of A(s), fill price = last_price of bar A(s), unit notional 1.0 per decision per symbol, no leverage parameter, no sizing conditioning
entry_exit_fills.exit: at close of A(s)+H, fill price = last_price of bar A(s)+H; no stop, no early exit
entry_exit_fills.fills_per_funded_decision: 2 (entry + exit), each charged cost exactly once (L-V14-0)

costs.authority: measured taker + spread schedule at stress tier 2.0 as PRIMARY (Q-2/Q-8), inherited from the V17 scored-driver kernel adoption at this cycle's P1 phase; cost exactly once per fill
costs.invention_disclaimer: NO cost constant is stated or invented in this proposal; the measured tier numbers come from the kernel's measured schedule at execution time. Measured beats stated everywhere.

anchor.rule: direction = sign(press over A-4..A-1); H = 8 bars
anchor.decisions: 8 instants x 3 symbols = 24 funded decisions (minus exact-tie skips, expected 0)

neighbour.rule: identical decision grid and H = 8; pre-window deepened to k = 8 bars (A-8..A-1)
neighbour.mechanism_support: if forced pre-completion pressure is real, a deeper accumulation window must capture more of the deadline flow and move the same direction; an unstable or sign-flipping deeper window contradicts the mechanism (different parameterization, same mechanism)

causal_placebo_control.rule: sham FOMC clock: each instant shifted -1 FOMC session index (session i date -> session i-1 date, same DST-correct release hour); session 1 has no predecessor -> dropped fail-closed
causal_placebo_control.decisions: 7 sessions x 3 symbols = 21 decisions; everything else identical to anchor (k = 4, H = 8)
causal_placebo_control.identifiability: the sham recomputes the pre-window pressure around real alternate trading hours with real microstructure; it CAN move the signal (Q-11 satisfied; a control that cannot move the signal would be INVALID NULL)

clock_only_shadow.rule: identical decision grid, holds (H = 8), costs and books; direction = +1 on odd chronological session index, -1 on even (deterministic from the calendar alone, carries zero panel information)
clock_only_shadow.purpose: isolates what the bare exogenous clock yields including its sign-alternating structure; if the anchor is subsumed by this exposure the mechanism claim is empty

arms.pairwise_distinctness: the four arms differ by (direction rule, pre-window k, H, instant map) and will carry distinct arm_config_digests at D2/I time; no two arms share all four

representation_identity.p12_statement: This block IS the representation D2 must measure pooled |rho| <= 0.20 on. Representation identity = measurement identity (FXFV9 lesson: no undisclosed variant grids).
representation_identity.grid: H1 rows keyed (symbol, hour_utc) from the three frozen S4 panels (digests pinned in p0_gate.json s4_repin); decision grid = 24 rows keyed (symbol, instant) over the 8 census instants
representation_identity.signal_computation: per decision row: press = (SUM_{A-4..A-1} buy_quote - SUM sell_quote) / SUM quote_total; d = sign(press); entry = last_price(A); exit = last_price(A+8)
representation_identity.per_decision_return: r = d * (exit/entry - 1), gross; after-cost r_net = r - 2 * fill_cost_tier2.0 / unit_notional
series_d2_measures: the 24-row per-decision after-cost return vector of ANCHOR (primary)
the same vectors for NEIGH-K8 for the ancestry panel
representation_identity.books: per-symbol books and the pooled 3-symbol book; equal unit notional per decision; no cross-sectional ranking, no normalization across symbols
representation_identity.no_hidden_variants: no alternate pre-window definition, no span variant, no sign-flipped re-computation exists or may be substituted at D2; any re-measure must use exactly this representation or be recorded as a NEW proposal

ancestry_defense: WKNDLIQ died because its weekend book WAS a low-liquidity-level exposure (pooled |rho| 0.5628 vs dvol proxies); P2's observable is a bounded net-pressure RATIO whose numerator is a side difference and whose denominator cancels the volume level - no liquidity level conditions anything, and the 8 exogenous instants are not a recurring weekday. FUNDJUMP's announced-change form still carried the funding LEVEL (rho 0.2439); P2 consumes no funding, no OI, no announcement content - only the census clock and panel flow columns. ATTN-PHASE was a daily recurring US-session phase on SOL; P2's clock is 8 non-recurring scheduled decision instants and its reaction window starts after the print, not at a session boundary. OICASCADE was an endogenous OI-collapse event book killed by its own randomized-event sham; P2 uses no OI and carries an instant-shifted sham of the same falsifying family. The generic-imbalance-continuation interpretation (the RUNPERSIST/taker-saturation neighborhood) is exactly what the sham-instant and clock-only controls are built to falsify.
distinctness_vs_sibling: P2's information source is the PRE-instant accumulated taker pressure over A-4..A-1 (deadline-forced flow while quotes still stand); P1 (CNG1-A4-P1) uses the POST-instant announcement-bar taker side (drained-book under-reaction). Different information-source layer AND different reaction form (realization drift vs continuation), not a parameter swap. Cross-proposal collapse is tested by frozen rule F5.

expected_failure_interpretation: If F1 fires, pre-print pressure carries no scheduled-clock information beyond generic H1 imbalance autocorrelation and the forced-pre-completion mechanism is dead on this substrate - it must not be re-clocked to other announcement series (CPI/NFP are BLOCKED, so no other legal clock exists in evidence). If F5 fires, the lane effectively produced one mechanism twice and the weaker is withdrawn before selection - an honest lane-level thinning, not a rescue. If F4 fires with coherent controls, it is a plain negative: deadline flow is noise at H1 granularity on these three books, or realization drift is smaller than measured tier-2.0 costs. Any of these outcomes feeds CRYPTO_NG1_REJECT_ALL, which the plan registers as a successful research run.
